title: #ad Had a shining, shimmering spectacular date night at Aladdin thank...
transcript: Looking for your next magical date night? Your wish has been granted at Disney's Aladdin on Broadway. Thanks, Disney for the tickets and swag bag. I saw the show 10 years ago with my parents, but I was so excited to share the magic of it with my boyfriend because he's never been to a Disney on Broadway show. Our first date was actually a Broadway show, so now we collect magnets at every show we see. And the merch at Aladdin was a 10 out of 10. You could feel the magic of Aladdin the second you walked into the theater. And I don't know who is more excited, me or my boyfriend. Speaking of magic, this show is even more magical than I remember. I lost count of how many times I got chills from the music to the set and the magic bit moment. Truly the most magical things I've seen on a Broadway stage. I also forgot how funny the show is. My cheeks are from smiling and laughing so much. We'd left that theater literally feeling like we are floating on our own magic carpet from having such a shining, shimmering, spectacular time. Thank you so much, Disney on Broadway for a magical night. For tickets to Aladdin, click the link in my bio.
reasoning: The reviewer expresses overwhelming enthusiasm with superlatives like 'most magical things I've seen on a Broadway stage' and 'shining, shimmering, spectacular time.' Despite being a sponsored post, the personal details and genuine emotional reactions indicate a strong positive experience and clear recommendation.
